output_list.criticism: The sub function does not handle underflow. If a is less than b, the result will be negative, which can lead to integer overflow.
The balanceOf function does not handle underflow. If the balance of an address is greater than the maximum value of uint256, the result will be incorrect.
The transfer function does not handle underflow. If the balance of the sender is less than the value to be transferred, the result will be incorrect.
The transferFrom function does not handle underflow. If the balance of the sender is less than the value to be transferred, the result will be incorrect.
The burn function does not handle underflow. If the balance of the sender is less than the value to be burned, the result will be incorrect.
